source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Collect the following data from the inspection record:
    1. Address
    2. Site code
    3. Unique inspection ID
    4. Inspection status (complete, pass, fail, incomplete, error)
3. Document which element of the inspection record indicates an accessibility
failure. Some examples include:
    1. A failure that occurs on the front page of the inspection
    2. A checkbox that indicates a failure
    3. A "remarks" box that explains a failure
4. Document the rule(s) that the failed inspection element could have violated.
5. On https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1M97355B3hD9d35gqM4V_QnYo3jF930XyVlFpAA4C0rM/edit?usp=sharing
add a new row with the
